## Task
What needs doing, in one sentence.

## Why
One line: tech debt, security advisory, prepares for X, etc.

## Scope
- Files / services touched
- No behavior change (or state what changes)

## Checklist
- [ ] Change made
- [ ] Tests still pass
- [ ] Docs / config updated if needed

## Risk
Low / medium / high — e.g. breaking changes in a new dep version.
